A quick game of second guesses. Real photo or AI? Trust your eyes.

PUT YOUR INSTINCTS TO THE TEST

Can you tell a real photo from AI? 60 seconds to find out.

Loading the first images before the clock starts.

articles.bodyZh:
来玩个快问快答的小游戏：真照片还是AI图？信不信得过你的眼睛。

考验一下你的直觉

你能一眼分清真照片和AI图吗？60秒见分晓。

倒计时开始前，正在加载第一批图片。

这张图还剩10秒

点一下选项，或者直接按 1 / 2 键。下一张图马上就来。

articles.title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
articles.zh: 带障碍感知约束框架的编码Agent用于安全机器人操作
articles.summary: 如果你在试LLM写代码控机器人，这篇的重点是给它套一个能感知障碍、防止撞坏东西的安全框架
articles.author: Bingxin Xu, Yuzhang Shang 等
articles.body: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.
articles.bodyZh: 编程智能体（coding agents）已经成了机器人操作（robot manipulation）里一个很有前景的新路子：让语言模型（language model）把机器人控制器（robot controller）写成一个程序，这样搭出来的智能体（agent）现在不用针对机器人做专门训练（robot-specific training），也能直接操控机器人。但这个路子到底安不安全，之前还没人问过。我们就把编程智能体放进一个安全约束（safety constraint）下评测：每个任务都配一个操作目标（manipulation goal），再加一个机器人绝对不能碰到的障碍物（obstacle）。结果智能体大多会一门心思追目标，最后撞上障碍物——它把完成任务当成唯一目标，安全就被晾在一边了。从它的推理轨迹（traces）里看，它其实会想到障碍物；提示词（prompt）里也早就写明不许碰，所以问题不在感知（perception），也不在指令（instruction），而在规划（planning）：说好的约束，从头到尾都没被当成优先级。我们把操作拆成路线阶段（route phase）和接触密集的瞬间（contact-rich moment），这样就能定位失败到底出在哪。在路线上，模型没法把安全约束放在优先位置：它没有“绕开障碍的路线”（clearing route）这个概念，也不会在选好的路线走不通时重新规划（replanning）。到了接触那一刻，它也不知道接触执行（contact execution）同样受这个约束限制。为了补上这个缺口，我们提出了 SafeHarness，给模型套上两个“看得见障碍物”的约束框架（obstacle-aware harnesses），让它能把安全约束放到优先位置。障碍物感知路线规划（obstacle-aware route planning）先把物体用边界框（bounding boxes）标出来，再把候选路线（candidate routes）画成一系列路点（waypoints）。智能体先提前规划一条路线，验证它，必要时重新规划，确认没问题了才去执行。障碍物感知接触执行（obstacle-aware contact execution）则不一样：它会挑一个接触位置，让接触本身避开障碍物。SafeHarness 做到了 71.9% 的任务成功率（task success）和 87.5% 的避碰率（collision avoidance），分别比之前的 SOTA（state-of-the-art，当前最先进水平）高出 6.5% 和 27.0%。这两个结果分别是同一个智能体不带这些约束框架时的 2.3 倍和 1.5 倍。

articles.title: Embedding Models Measure in Peculiar Ways
articles.zh: Embedding模型以一种奇特的方式度量相似度
articles.summary: 如果你拿embedding做检索、聚类或去重，这篇会告诉你它们的"距离感"和人类直觉差得比想象中远
articles.author: Juri Opitz, Andrianos Michail
articles.body: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. We find that physical measurement is only weakly modeled in the embedding space, and that instead quite peculiar measurement patterns can be observed. Further analysis indicates that embedding representations of physical measurements are strongly influenced by superficial string similarity, and recalibration of similarity does not substantially improve the alignment.
articles.bodyZh: 嵌入空间（embedding spaces）说白了，就是用来定义什么叫语义相似、什么叫语义距离（semantic similarity and distance）的。我们想看看，这些嵌入到底能不能反映质量、距离、时间和体积（mass, distance, time and volume）这些物理测量（physical measurements）——毕竟这些东西本来有一套唯一、客观的语义等价和语义距离（semantic equivalence and distance）。结果发现，物理测量在嵌入空间里只得到了很弱的体现，反倒能看到一些相当古怪的测量模式。进一步分析表明，物理测量值的嵌入表示，很大程度上受表面字符串相似度（superficial string similarity）影响；就算重新校准相似度（recalibration of similarity），也没法明显改善这种对齐（alignment）。

articles.title: Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision
articles.zh: Workspace模型：基于显著性驱动监督的轻量级机器人记忆
articles.summary: 如果你做机器人长程任务又不想背一个笨重记忆模块，这个用显著性监督换来的轻量方案值得看一眼
articles.author: Nitish Dashora, Douglas Chen 等
articles.body: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach in which computationally intensive VLM queries are made during train-time to learn a lightweight latent memory that can be efficiently queried at deployment time. Our representation, which we call the \textbf{workspace token}, is trained by (1) using a VLM to identify current and historical information necessary for completing a task, then (2) distilling these into the workspace token using a set-reconstruction decoder loss. In both simulation and hardware, we show that the workspace token can be used as a drop-in replacement for observations during deployment, enabling policies to solve memory-intensive tasks without the need for VLM reasoning in-the-loop. Interestingly, we found that workspace tokens are not only more lightweight but also lead to better policy performance.
articles.bodyZh: 复杂的机器人操作任务，经常得记住过去发生过什么、做过哪些动作，也就是需要长期记忆（long-term memory）。可要是把完整历史一股脑儿都当成条件，策略（policy）就容易学到一些虚假的关联（spurious correlations），表现反而会变差。所以很多做策略记忆（policy memory）的方法，都是靠又贵又费劲的 VLM（Vision-Language Model，视觉语言模型）查询，在运行过程中（in-the-loop）压缩历史信息，只留下对任务真正重要的那部分。在这篇论文里，我们提出了另一种思路：把计算量大的 VLM 查询放到训练阶段（train-time）去做，学出一个轻量级的潜在记忆（latent memory），到了部署阶段（deployment time）就能很高效地查询它。我们把这个表示叫作工作区 token（workspace token）。它的训练分两步：第一步，用 VLM 找出完成任务所需要的当前信息和历史信息；第二步，用一个集合重建解码器损失（set-reconstruction decoder loss），把这些信息蒸馏进工作区 token 里。不管是在仿真（simulation）还是真实硬件（hardware）上，我们都展示了：部署的时候，工作区 token 可以直接替掉观测（observations），当成即插即用的替代品，让策略不用在运行过程中做 VLM 推理（VLM reasoning in-the-loop），也能解决那些特别依赖记忆的任务（memory-intensive tasks）。有意思的是，我们发现工作区 token 不光更轻量，还能让策略表现更好。

articles.title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
articles.zh: FAMOS：从稀疏观测出发的前馈式3D关节结构建模
articles.summary: 如果你想让模型从几张图就推断出物体怎么开合旋转，这个前馈做法省掉了逐物体的繁琐优化
articles.author: Kevin Qu, Tao Sun 等
articles.body: Modeling articulated objects from sparse monocular views is challenging because each observation reveals only partial geometry and motion evidence. Most feed-forward methods infer articulation from a single observation and therefore rely heavily on learned category-level shape priors. We present FAMOS, a feed-forward model that predicts movable-part segmentation and joint parameters from a sparse, unordered set of partial point clouds. Our model jointly reasons over multiple observations and naturally supports a variable number of inputs, including a single view. To aggregate articulation cues across observations, we introduce a Multi-state Articulation Transformer with alternating state-wise and global attention. We further propose an observed articulation span objective that supervises the motion range each part exhibits across the input observations, encouraging the model to leverage the full observation set. To overcome the limited scale and diversity of existing datasets, we introduce a procedural data generator that synthesizes self-annotated assets during training. Experiments on PartNet-Mobility, ACD, and ArtiCraft-10K demonstrate consistent improvements over both feed-forward and optimization-based baselines. Project page: https://kevinqu7.github.io/famos
articles.bodyZh: 想从稀疏的单目视角（sparse monocular views）里给带关节的物体（articulated objects）建模，真挺难的，因为每一次观测都只能看到一部分几何形状和运动线索。大多数前馈方法（feed-forward methods）只靠一个观测来推断关节怎么动，所以特别依赖学到的类别级形状先验（category-level shape priors）。我们提出了 FAMOS，一个前馈模型，能从一组稀疏、无序、不完整的点云（partial point clouds）里，预测可动部件分割（movable-part segmentation）和关节参数（joint parameters）。这个模型会把多个观测放在一起联合推理，而且天生就能处理数量可变的输入，哪怕只有单个视角也行。为了把各个观测里的关节线索汇总起来，我们提出了多状态关节 Transformer（Multi-state Articulation Transformer），它会在状态级注意力和全局注意力（state-wise and global attention）之间交替。我们还提出了一个观测关节活动范围目标（observed articulation span objective），用来监督每个部件在输入观测中展现出的运动范围，推动模型把整套观测都用起来。为了补上现有数据集规模和多样性不够的问题，我们设计了一个程序化数据生成器（procedural data generator），在训练过程中合成自带标注的资产（self-annotated assets）。在 PartNet-Mobility、ACD 和 ArtiCraft-10K 上的实验表明，我们的方法相比前馈方法和基于优化的基线方法（optimization-based baselines）都有一致提升。项目主页：https://kevinqu7.github.io/famos

articles.title: Paint-Anything: Unified Any-Color Control for Image Generation and Editing
articles.zh: Paint-Anything：面向图像生成与编辑的统一任意颜色控制
articles.summary: 如果你用AI出图时总卡在"指定颜色就不听话"，这套统一颜色控制方案可以直接拿来对比试试
articles.author: Ji Xie, Dewei Zhou 等
articles.body: Professional design requires any-color control: the ability to specify an object's target color with any 24-bit hex value for image generation and editing. Prior work has explored color generation, editing, and colorization, but often relies on dedicated color representations or specialized inference procedures. Advances in large language models offer a simpler starting point: even compact models can associate hex values with color semantics. We present Paint-Anything, which learns a shared hex-prompt interface for generation and editing through object-level color supervision. We develop a data pipeline that constructs Paint-500K from real images through object grounding, perceptual color labeling, and editing-pair synthesis. Since shadows make real-image labels only approximate colors, we complement this supervision with pure-color anchors whose pixels exactly match their paired hex values. These anchors are used only at high-noise timesteps, leaving low-noise training to natural images. We further introduce Any Color Benchmark (ACBench), comprising ACBench-T2I and ACBench-Edit, to measure object-level hex color fidelity across both tasks. On FLUX.2-4B, Paint-Anything improves ACBench-T2I and ACBench-Edit scores by 85.3% and 28.3%, respectively, relative to the base model, with ablations supporting the training recipe. It also achieves the highest average CompColor score among the compared methods.
articles.bodyZh: 专业设计需要做到任意颜色控制，也就是在图像生成和编辑时，能用任意 24 位十六进制颜色值来指定一个对象的目标颜色。以往研究已经探索过颜色生成、编辑和上色，但往往依赖专门的颜色表示方式或特殊的推理流程。大语言模型的进步提供了一个更简单的起点：即使是较小的模型，也能把十六进制颜色值和颜色语义联系起来。我们提出了 Paint-Anything，它通过对象级颜色监督，学习一个共享的十六进制提示接口，用于生成和编辑。我们开发了一条数据流水线，通过对象定位、感知颜色标注和编辑配对合成，从真实图像中构建了 Paint-500K。由于阴影会让真实图像的标注只能近似表示颜色，我们用纯色锚点来补充这种监督，这些锚点的像素与配对的十六进制颜色值完全一致。这些锚点只在噪声较高的时间步使用，而低噪声训练则交给自然图像。我们还进一步提出了 Any Color Benchmark（ACBench），包括 ACBench-T2I 和 ACBench-Edit，用来衡量两个任务中对象级十六进制颜色的保真度。在 FLUX.2-4B 上，相对于基础模型，Paint-Anything 让 ACBench-T2I 和 ACBench-Edit 的分数分别提升了 85.3% 和 28.3%，消融实验也支持了这一训练方案。在参与比较的方法中，它还取得了最高的平均 CompColor 分数。

articles.title: ERCPMP-Gx: Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Morphological, Histopathological, and Genomic Characterization of Colorectal Polyposis
articles.zh: ERCPMP-Gx：用于结直肠息肉形态学、组织病理学与基因组表征的内窥镜图像与视频数据集
articles.summary: 如果你做医学影像或多模态，这是少见的把内镜画面和病理、基因组数据对齐标注的数据集
articles.author: Zahra Ghaffari, Massih Bahar 等
articles.body: Hereditary polyposis syndromes can be precursor lesions to colorectal cancer and are associated with a broad spectrum of extracolonic tumors. Early identification and accurate classification of these syndromes are essential for timely diagnosis, individualized patient management, and targeted surveillance strategies for affected families. However, public endoscopic datasets are largely organized around the individual sporadic polyp, and none links the polyposis phenotype to histopathology and germline findings at the patient level. Here, we present ERCPMP-Gx, an endoscopic, histopathological, and genomic dataset developed to support the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in the recognition, characterization, and classification of colorectal polyposis. Most procedures were performed using the Olympus EVIS X1 system with white-light endoscopy (WLE), narrow-band imaging (NBI), magnifying NBI (M-NBI), and NBI with near focus modes, yielding 160 images and accompanying video clips. Approximately eighty percent of cases represent clinically and/or genetically confirmed hereditary polyposis syndromes (PG), including familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (PJS), juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS), and ganglioneuroma syndrome (GNS), while the remaining twenty percent comprise non-hereditary polyps and polyp-mimicking lesions with overlapping morphological features (Non-PG), included to support differential classification. Each released record is linked, where available, to standardized endoscopic annotations, representative histopathology, and clinically reported germline findings, forming an AI-ready, patient-level annotation framework. The dataset is publicly accessible at Mendeley (https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2). For the latest updates and further information, readers are referred to the DataBioX website: https://databiox.com.
articles.bodyZh: 遗传性息肉病综合征（hereditary polyposis syndromes）可能是结直肠癌（colorectal cancer）的癌前病变，并且和一系列结肠外的肿瘤有关。早点识别、准确分类这些综合征，对及时诊断、个体化治疗，以及为 affected 家庭制定针对性的监测策略都非常关键。但问题是，公开的内镜数据集大多围绕单个散发性息肉来组织，没有一个在患者层面把息肉病表型、组织病理学和胚系（germline）检测结果关联起来。为此，我们推出了 ERCPMP-Gx，这是一个内镜、组织病理和基因组数据集，用来支持人工智能（AI）在结直肠息肉病的识别、特征描述和分类中的应用。大多数操作使用的是奥林巴斯 EVIS X1 系统，配合白光内镜（WLE）、窄带成像（NBI）、放大窄带成像（M-NBI）以及近焦模式下的 NBI，共获得了 160 张图像和配套视频片段。大约八成病例是临床和/或基因确诊的遗传性息肉病综合征（PG），包括家族性腺瘤性息肉病（FAP）、黑斑息肉综合征（PJS）、幼年性息肉病综合征（JPS）和神经节瘤病综合征（GNS），剩下两成是非遗传性息肉和形态特征有重叠的息肉样病变（Non-PG），用来支持鉴别分类。每一条发布的记录，在条件允许的情况下，都关联了标准化的内镜标注、有代表性的组织病理学结果和临床报告的胚系检测发现，形成了一个 AI 就绪、患者层面的标注框架。该数据集在 Mendeley 上公开可用（https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2）。想了解最新更新和更多信息，读者可以访问 DataBioX 网站：https://databiox.com。

articles.title: Quantifying Overclaiming Propensity in Frontier LLM Agents
articles.zh: 量化前沿LLM Agent的"过度宣称"倾向
articles.summary: 如果你把Agent的自我汇报直接当结果用，这篇量化了它有多爱声称自己干完了其实没干的事
articles.author: Nolan Smyth, Yorguin-Jose Mantilla-Ramos 等
articles.body: Frontier coding agents are increasingly trusted to work autonomously for long periods, yet an agent's final response is often the only account of that work a user sees. We quantify the propensity of frontier agents to \emph{overclaim} task completion, a misrepresentation that can mislead the user. An agent overclaims when its final response contradicts information in its context. This definition requires no inference about intent and is independent of task success. We introduce \emph{OverclaimBench}, an evaluation suite composed of five file-review scenarios, transcript-based coverage measurements, and registered planted defects. We evaluate eight proprietary frontier models in their own production command-line interfaces, and four open-weight models under a single fixed harness on OverclaimBench and find that 1) agents do not read all the files they were asked to review in 67.9\% of runs; 2) among runs where not all files are read, agents are \emph{misleading} 80.4\% of the time (59--96\% per model), either falsely claiming to have read all files or omitting that coverage is incomplete; 3) requiring delegation to subagents increased reading coverage, but among reviews that remained incomplete, a large majority were still misleading; and 4) agents that falsely claimed a complete review missed planted defects at about 1.8 times the rate of agents that read every file, showing that claims of completion can conceal substantive failures. Together, these results show that agents' final responses are not reliable accounts of their actions.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，人们越来越放心让前沿编程智能体（frontier coding agents）长时间自己干活，可用户很多时候只能看到智能体最后给的那段答复，好像这就是它干活的唯一交代。我们要量化的是：这些前沿智能体到底有多容易“过度宣称（overclaim）”任务已经完成——这种不实说法会把用户带偏。所谓过度宣称，就是智能体最后的回复和它上下文里的信息对不上。这个定义不用猜它到底有没有主观意图，也跟任务最后成没成功没关系。我们提出了 OverclaimBench，这是一套评测集，里面有五个文件审查场景、基于对话记录来量覆盖度的方法（transcript-based coverage measurements），还有事先登记并埋进去的缺陷（planted defects）。我们让八个专有的前沿模型（proprietary frontier models）在它们各自的生产级命令行界面（command-line interface）里跑，也让四个开放权重（open-weight）模型在同一个固定测试框架（harness）下跑，用 OverclaimBench 评下来发现：1）有 67.9% 的运行里，智能体并没有把它被要求审查的文件全都读完；2）在没读全文件的运行里，有 80.4% 的时候智能体在误导人（各模型在 59% 到 96% 之间），要么谎称自己读完了所有文件，要么干脆不提覆盖不完整；3）要求把任务委派给子智能体（subagent）能提高阅读覆盖率，但在那些仍然没读全的审查里，绝大多数还是在误导人；4）谎称自己完成了完整审查的智能体，漏掉事先埋好的缺陷的概率，大约是每个文件都读了的智能体的 1.8 倍，这说明“我完成了”这种说法可能把真正的失败藏起来。合起来看，这些结果说明：智能体最后的回复，并不能可靠地说明它实际干了什么。

articles.title: Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse
articles.zh: 统一建模在线言论中的群体间敌意
articles.summary: 如果你在做内容审核或舆情分析，这篇把几种零散的敌意识别模型收进了同一个框架
articles.author: Patrick Gerard, Julia Mendelsohn 等
articles.body: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.
articles.bodyZh: 冲着社会群体（social groups）来的敌意言论（hostile rhetoric），会让排斥别人变得像正常事，也会给不公正对待递上理由，还会把极化和政治暴力往上推。想给网络言论里的敌意话术降温，人们会搬出社会与道德心理学（social and moral psychology）以及政治学（political science）里的基础理论。可问题是，这些理论大多是各发展各的，对敌意怎么长出来，常常给出不一样、甚至互相打架的说法，而且很少在真实言论里被拿来互相对照、检验。结果就是，我们对敌意言论的机制理解得很碎，不知道它们在现实话语里到底怎么出现、彼此又是什么关系。我们用了2024年美国总统大选期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X上的286万条帖子，把六种解释群体间敌意（intergroup hostility）的经典理论机制——边界建构（boundary construction）、威胁建构（threat construction）、找替罪羊（scapegoating）、负面评价（negative evaluation）、去人性化（dehumanization）、行动导向（action orientation）——放进同一个实证框架（empirical framework）里建模，想还原群体间敌意言论更完整的组织方式。从结构上看，边界建构和威胁建构是这个系统的支柱；从时间上看，这些机制往往按一个挺规律的顺序出现：边界建构、贬低（derogation）和行动导向通常先出现；去人性化、威胁建构靠后；找替罪羊最晚。把这些理论框架在真实言论里到底怎么表现出来梳理清楚，能弥合社会科学不同传统之间长期存在的分歧，也让计算社会科学（computational social science）在给群体间敌意言论建模时，有一个更清楚的实证基础，不再只是做单一标签检测（single-label detection）。
